scope: The former Exhibition Building and Concert Hall at 480 Gregory Terrace, Brisbane, as a restored exterior around August 2019. Includes the full T-shaped historic structure, prominent terracotta and cream bands, concert and exhibition fronts, round arches, tall paired towers and low metal hall roofs.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Brisbane City Council identifies the state-registered former Exhibition Building and Concert Hall at 480 Gregory Terrace.

The original conservation management plan documents the T plan and which hall occupies each arm, paired towers at the hall entrances, veranda, dark glazed brick basement, red and cream masonry and corrugated iron roofs.
